{"repair": "review-01", "reason": "R3：依本侧参考修复外弧、内弯尖梢、发面宽度和间隙；保留实际非对称及5/20/150分片，不把宽帘提到耳前。", "geometry": "Complete native part contour after visual repair; opacity contours are only vector export, not a colour-threshold painting operation.", "previous_svg": "workspace/repair-01/upstream-before/hair/side_hair_left.svg"}
